title: Building Trustworthy Multimodal AI: A Review of Fairness, Transparency, and Ethics in Vision-Language Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies on gender bias inheritance from foundation models (like CLIP) and evaluating mitigation metrics and debiasing techniques in image captioning and visual dialogue tasks.
Synthesizing research on how the skin color of depicted individuals influences model performance, word choices, and representational harms in vision-language tasks.
Examining literature on performance disparities across languages, specifically focusing on inherent preferences for well-supported languages like English in multilingual models.
Reviewing analytical methods that assess model behavior and representational harms based on protected characteristics such as religion in image captioning.
Evaluating multi-modal frameworks designed to generate culturally-aware image captions and mitigate cultural insensitivity.
